summary_bullets: Clarify that Monitor is banned for one-shot completion waits in /implement and /design.
Define the narrow premature-notification recovery path as one immediate-background completion waiter.
Pin the Monitor-ban and recovery-contract literals in the structural anti-polling harness.
commit_message:
Document Monitor one-shot wait ban

Add explicit /implement and /design guidance banning Monitor for one-shot completion tracking, and document the narrow premature-notification recovery waiter exception. Extend the anti-polling structural harness and sibling docs to pin the new literals.
